name: worktrees
description: Parallel agents in git worktrees: spawn N Claude Code or Codex sessions in their own worktrees and tmux windows with a merged append-only log, check and broadcast to their panes (parallel-worktrees, pw), coordinate a contract-first fan-out of one issue across workers (contract-fanout), start a branch with pinned WIP branches stacked on it (stack-branches), and carry local agent tooling as one removable commit (stack-claude)
